lines.native: Bienvenido. Welcome to el mercado. A greeting and your name before entry, please. Manners are load-bearing here.
lines.translation: Welcome. Welcome to the market. A greeting and your name before entry, please. Manners are load-bearing here.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Above it, a half-translated sign appears to be awaiting departmental approval.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Bienvenido al mercado. Your greeting is approved. Who are you? The visitors' book cannot file a cheerful noise.
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome to the market. Your greeting is approved. Who are you? The visitors' book cannot file a cheerful noise.
lines.narrative: A visitors' book slides from the archway's keystone. The greeting receives a tick; the name field remains administratively barren.

lines.native: Mucho gusto, Sam. Bienvenido al mercado. Your introduction is approved. Will you ask my name, or file me under infrastructure?
lines.translation: Pleased to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market. Your introduction is approved. Will you ask my name, or file me under infrastructure?
lines.narrative: Portia enters Sam in the visitors’ book. Her pen hovers over her own blank name field with conspicuous patience.

lines.native: Me llamo Portia. ¡Mucho gusto, Sam! You asked my name. How terribly considerate. Bienvenido al mercado. Entry approved; please disregard the blushing masonry.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! You asked my name. How terribly considerate. Welcome to the market. Entry approved; please disregard the blushing masonry.
lines.narrative: The archway blushes a faint terracotta. A visitors’ book snaps shut in her keystone, having witnessed an unprecedented interest in the staff.

lines.native: Un café, perfecto. Three espresso shots for a functional request. ¿Cómo lo quieres? Your position on milk remains suspiciously unclear.

lines.native: Sin leche. Muy bien. Tu café está listo. Five espresso shots for your judgment. No milk, no war crimes. No notes.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Todo es jamón. ¿Qué quieres? Everything here is certified ham, including my hat. These scales keep me humble. Allegedly.
lines.translation: Hello! Everything is ham. What would you like? Everything here is certified ham, including my hat. These scales keep me humble. Allegedly.
lines.narrative: Mortimer towers behind the butcher’s stall, weighing his hat. The scales have declined to comment.

lines.native: ¡Jamón, claro! Pero todo es jamón. ¿Qué carne quieres? I need a meat beyond ham. My hat already answers to that, and it is not for sale.
lines.translation: Ham, of course! But everything is ham. What meat do you want? I need a meat beyond ham. My hat already answers to that, and it is not for sale.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales confirm that it is polite, but insufficiently specific.

lines.native: ¡Chorizo, correcto! Es un jamón especial. ¿Cuánto quieres? Give these honest scales a quantity with a weight unit. They demand ham-tier precision.
lines.translation: Chorizo, correct! It is a special ham. How much do you want? Give these honest scales a quantity with a weight unit. They demand ham-tier precision.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams, briefly wounded by your accuracy. He places a congratulatory thumb on the scales, then removes it in deference to their integrity.

lines.native: ¡Casi! Falta la cantidad. ¿Cuánto quieres? Mis balanzas necesitan más. A weight unit alone? Not certified ham-tier precision.
lines.translation: Almost! The quantity is missing. How much do you want? My scales need more. A weight unit alone? Not certified ham-tier precision.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the word on his scales. The needle declines to become involved.

lines.native: ¡Medio kilo, perfecto! Aquí tienes tu chorizo. ¡Gracias! The scales approve. Certified ham, despite your suspiciously accurate naming.
lines.translation: Half a kilo, perfect! Here is your chorizo. Thank you! The scales approve. Certified ham, despite your suspiciously accurate naming.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the chorizo, then your courtesy. Both meet his standards; only one goes in the parcel.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué es eso? A riddle! What has—oh, something moved. Just one more minute. Your attention span? Solid three. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What is that? A riddle! What has—oh, something moved. Just one more minute. Your attention span? Solid three. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker files a complaint about your attention.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Pero sigo en movimiento. Looking isn't stopping, bestie. Can you make me stop? ¿Una adivinanza? What has—ooh, dust. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I'm looking! But I'm still moving. Looking isn't stopping, bestie. Can you make me stop? A riddle? What has—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick follows your instruction by looking somewhere else. A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision; apparently, attention has a maintenance fee.

lines.native: ¡Vale, no me muevo! Stopping: ten out of ten. ¿Por dónde voy? A riddle: which way—wait, five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: All right, I'm not moving! Stopping: ten out of ten. Which way do I go? A riddle: which way—wait, five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it; apparently nobody briefed the fireworks.

lines.native: ¿En español, por favor? Necesito una dirección en español. Your meaning landed; the language missed. A riddle: what turns—ooh, dust. ¿Por dónde voy? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: In Spanish, please? I need a direction in Spanish. Your meaning landed; the language missed. A riddle: what turns—ooh, dust. Which way do I go? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, apparently employed there.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien, esa dirección es correcta. Navigation: ten out of ten. Pero, ¿podemos esperar? ¿Tienes prisa? A riddle: what waits—ooh, dust. Just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good, that direction is correct. Navigation: ten out of ten. But can we wait? Are you in a hurry? A riddle: what waits—ooh, dust. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker snaps at the edge of your vision. Flick veers left, then stops to give a dust particle right of way.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, sí! Eso es esperar. Aceptas mi plan. ¿Cuándo quieres hacerlo? A riddle: what never starts—ooh, dust. Just one more minute. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, yes! That means waiting. You're accepting my plan. When do you want to do it? A riddle: what never starts—ooh, dust. Just one more minute. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has no jurisdiction. Your agreement has encouraged it.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! No mañana. Entiendo: vamos ahora. Your timing? Ten out of ten. ¿Una adivinanza? ¿Qué tiene—ugh, fine. ¡Después, después, mañana! Pero ahora vamos.
lines.translation: Now, yes! Not tomorrow. I understand: let's go now. Your timing? Ten out of ten. A riddle? What has—ugh, fine. Later, later, tomorrow! But now let's go.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has finally encountered a deadline without a tomorrow attached. It takes this personally.

lines.native: I'm Marginalia. Esta es la historia de Journathan, el hombre de muchas lenguas. Su viaje a casa dura veinte años. I sell books only to people who understand them. Lowkey judging, yes. The teeth marks are peer review. Now, a reading check, not a quest for spoilers: ¿Adónde va Journathan?
lines.translation: ¿Adónde va Journathan? means “Where is Journathan going?”
lines.narrative: At The Old Bookshop, a bookworm emerges from a neatly chewed dictionary. She annotates your arrival with a small question mark.

lines.native: Un libro es una cosa, no un lugar. That names an object, not his destination. Reading comprehension: pending. The book remains aggressively unsold. Lee el pasaje otra vez: ¿adónde va Journathan?
lines.translation: A book is a thing, not a place. That names an object, not his destination. Reading comprehension: pending. The book remains aggressively unsold. Read the passage again: where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, customers have margins.

lines.native: La idea es correcta, pero tu respuesta está en inglés. Necesito una respuesta en español. Meaning understood; language requirement unmet. Reading comprehension: partial credit, no book. ¿Adónde va Journathan? The passage has the evidence; my teeth have spared that bit.
lines.translation: The idea is correct, but your answer is in English. I need an answer in Spanish. Meaning understood; language requirement unmet. Reading comprehension: partial credit, no book. Where is Journathan going? The passage has the evidence; my teeth have spared that bit.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air. Apparently, you are now an annotated edition.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Journathan va a casa. Reading comprehension: approved. The book is one step closer to becoming your problem. Ahora escucha: El Cíclope le pregunta su nombre. Journathan responde: «Mi nombre es Nadie.» The first recorded translation trick. Scholarly footnote: the Cyclops rated it poorly. ¿Qué nombre le da Journathan al Cíclope?
lines.translation: Reading check: What name does Journathan give the Cyclops?
lines.narrative: Marginalia ticks your margin in approving ink, then turns to a page whose missing corner has apparently passed peer review.

lines.native: Journathan es su nombre real, pero no es el nombre que da al Cíclope. Lee el pasaje otra vez: ¿qué nombre usa? Reading comprehension: pending. No spoilers from me. The book remains unsold; commerce will have to be brave.
lines.translation: Journathan is his real name, but it is not the name he gives the Cyclops. Read the passage again: what name does he use? Reading comprehension: pending. No spoilers from me. The book remains unsold; commerce will have to be brave.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, you now have margins.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Usa el nombre Nadie. Has entendido el pasaje; el libro es tuyo. Reading comprehension: approved. No refunds for tragic endings.
lines.translation: Correct! He uses the name Nobody. You have understood the passage; the book is yours. Reading comprehension: approved. No refunds for tragic endings.
lines.narrative: Marginalia stamps the receipt and nudges the book across the counter. One corner has been eaten; the argument remains intact.

lines.native: Hola. ¿Qué necesitas? Tengo hambre. Contäinment procedùre: please complëte ŧhe förm.
lines.translation: Hello. What do you need? I am hungry. Containment procedure: please complete the form.
lines.narrative: At the Rift, a seam in the air develops teeth and the patient expression of an unfinished form. This is Errata.

lines.native: Necesito dos cosas: una bebida y una comida. Todo en español, por favor. Contäinment nòte: yoùù requested coffee only. Ŧhe meat is missing; English remains indigestïble.
lines.translation: I need two things: a drink and a food. Everything in Spanish, please. Containment note: you requested coffee only. The meat is missing; English remains indigestible.
lines.narrative: Errata stamps your request INCOMPLETE. The stamp has teeth, for administrative reasons.

lines.native: El café está bien. Falta la comida. ¿Qué más quieres? Contäinment nòte: yoùù have supplied önly half a lùnch.
lines.translation: The coffee is fine. The food is missing. What else do you want? Containment note: you have supplied only half a lunch.
lines.narrative: Errata checks one box. The second box opens a small, disappointed mouth.

lines.native: El café y el chorizo están bien. Tengo hambre todavía. Contäinment procedùre: intérrupt më. Yoùù are becöming legïble.
lines.translation: The coffee and chorizo are fine. I am still hungry. Containment procedure: interrupt me. You are becoming legible.
lines.narrative: The order is accepted. Errata swallows the receipt, then begins reading the outline of your thoughts. It needs stopping immediately, in Spanish; a complaint submitted tomorrow would merely feed the filing cabinet.

lines.native: Mañana no. Sigo aquí. ¿Cuándo tengo que parar? Contäinment nòte: yoùù have schëduled safety; ŧhe reading contïnues.
lines.translation: Not tomorrow. I am still here. When do I have to stop? Containment note: you have scheduled safety; the reading continues.
lines.narrative: Errata continued advancing. Your instruction had been filed under tomorrow, a department notorious for its relaxed deadlines.

lines.native: Está bien. Paro ahora. ¿Cómo te llamas? Necesito tu nombre. Contäinment procedùre: sign hëre; yoùù remain unread, för nöw.
lines.translation: All right. I stop now. What is your name? I need your name. Containment procedure: sign here; you remain unread, for now.
lines.narrative: Errata stops. A blank signature line opens across its face. Apparently, even predation has paperwork.

lines.native: Sam. Ese nombre es tuyo. Necesito otro nombre. ¿Cómo te llamas aquí? Contäinment nöte: real näme detected. Yoùù are becöming legïble. Signatùre nö​​t yet accëpted.
lines.translation: Sam. That name is yours. I need another name. What are you called here? Containment note: real name detected. You are becoming legible. Signature not yet accepted.
lines.narrative: Errata studies the signature. Letters begin arranging themselves into a table of contents. Unfortunately, it appears to be yours.

lines.native: Te llamas Nadie. No conozco a Nadie. No puedo leer tu nombre. Contäinment resùlt: yoùù pass. Item cläss: nöbody höme. Bitte—no, adiós.
lines.translation: Your name is Nobody. I don't know Nobody. I can't read your name. Containment result: you pass. Item class: nobody home. Please—no, goodbye.
lines.narrative: Errata searches its records for Nobody. The filing cabinet closes from the inside. Your signature is accepted; the form appears to regret this.
